# `box.reshape`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/box.reshape.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`box.reshape` (`ReshapeBox`, FR-DEV-039): replaces the outline of a black box (a representation with a `box`),
and its connection points with `cps`, or re-projects them onto the new outline.

- `outline` is relative to the representation's `pos` (under its orientation, as `box.black` stores it): at
  least three vertices, each on the page's connection grid in absolute terms (`pos + orient(v)`).
- **With `cps`** the box's CPs are replaced: function CP indices distinct, each CP on the grid in absolute terms
  and on the outline (on an edge `v(i) v(i+1)`, the outline closed).
- **Without `cps`** every CP is re-projected (doc 06 §8 item 13): it keeps the index of the edge it lay on (the
  first edge containing it, in outline order) and its offset from that edge's first vertex (measured along the
  edge's axis), clamped to the new edge's length and snapped to the grid point along the edge nearest to it
  (ties toward the edge's first vertex); its direction is kept. A CP whose edge index no longer exists, or that
  lay on no edge, moves to the nearest grid point on the nearest remaining edge (ties by the smaller edge index)
  and leaves along that edge's outward normal, listed as a notice. On an edge that is neither horizontal nor
  vertical the grid point is the edge's first vertex (polygon outlines are a follow-up, WP-S2.04 §17.4 item 6),
  also listed as a notice.
- Inner graphics are kept. Routes of the connections on the page at the box's CPs follow each moved CP
  (`geometry::follow_end`).

Rejected: a representation that does not exist or has no box; fewer than three outline vertices or one off the
grid; with `cps`, two CPs with one index, a CP off the grid or off the outline; a box CP that a connection on
the page ends at and that the new CPs no longer draw (keep it in `cps`). Interactive. Outcome: the
representation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cps` | array of [`BoxCp`](#boxcp) or `null` | no |  | The new connection points; absent re-projects the current ones. |
| `outline` | array of [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2) | yes |  | The new outline, relative to the representation's position. |
| `rep` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The black box's representation. |

## Types

### BoxCp

One CP of a black box: function CP index, position and direction.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | [`Dir4`](#dir4) | yes |  | The direction a wire leaves the CP. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The function CP index. |
| `pos` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | Position relative to the representation. |

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Dir4

One of four directions on the sheet.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"up"` | Up (−y). |
| `"right"` | Right (+x). |
| `"down"` | Down (+y). |
| `"left"` | Left (−x). |

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
